digest.component_or_area: op-cert trusted gate service and remote-cert client
propositions: The opcert service must implement an async job API that accepts POST /opcert/jobs with only ticket_id and kind, ignores any other client-supplied fields, enqueues the job, and returns 202 with job_id; clients cannot influence bound values in the signed cert.

The service worker must fetch authoritative state (tickets branch and review remote main) with its own credentials, derive material_fingerprint and merged_log_commit server-side, and dispatch per-kind (plan-review -> rebar.llm.review_plan, completion-verifier -> rebar.llm.verify_completion) with asymmetric error handling (verify_completion raises LLMError -> job error; review_plan degrades to INDETERMINATE in-band).

The service must materialize the SSM SecureString Ed25519 key to a 0600 mkstemp file for ssh-keygen -Y sign invocation, set REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH and REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID, and delete the file in a finally block after signing; the key must be passphrase-free.

The server must run each job in an ephemeral workspace with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off and no push credentials, so SIGNATURE events land only in the discarded workspace and never on the shared tickets branch; the remote-cert client persists the returned envelope as a SIGNATURE event.

The remote-cert client command must read verify.opcert_remote_url, SigV4-sign the request, poll to terminal status, persist the envelope on PASS, and exit non-zero on non-PASS or error; the returned envelope must be self-authenticating against tampering.
